title: Addition laws
blurb: The four axioms of addition — the one operation that stands alone, presupposing nothing else in the tower.

title: Multiplication laws
blurb: Multiplication's own four axioms, mirroring addition's; the two worlds meet only through distributivity.

title: Distribution
blurb: The single bridge between the addition and multiplication worlds — distributivity, its backward reading (collecting like terms), and what it forces (0 times anything is 0).

title: Sign & minus laws
blurb: Subtraction is not a new operation but adding the inverse; every minus-sign rule follows from that one definition.

title: Fraction laws
blurb: Division is not a new operation but multiplying by the reciprocal; all fraction rules follow.

title: Power laws
blurb: Powers repeat multiplication as multiples repeat addition; the three power laws fall out of counting factors.

title: Root laws
blurb: Roots name the reverse question of powers; their rules are the power laws read backward.

title: Binomial formulas
blurb: The familiar product shapes you learn to recognize on sight — where spotting the form is the whole trick.
